items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, affiliate, and data boundaries. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, authorize no rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, deployment, or external permission outreach without human-counsel review and owner authorization. Evidence: Woot API documentation establishes access mechanics but not commercial/public display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, images, prices, trademarks, affiliate, or advertising rights; public Woot terms restrict those uses. Fleet compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Analytics is yellow; failing sources are not zero. Revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and unattributed. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, incident, accuracy, and measurement bundle.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Continue only the existing evidence workstream; close tasks only when the required artifacts and technical, security, measurement, and owner gates are evidenced.

Site-specific decision: retain complicated.work parked until banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 failures are remediated. Retain deadlymaracas.com parked until DNS reachability and a concrete compliance checklist are evidenced. Do not infer audience, revenue, compliance, or launch readiness from missing telemetry.
